filters.name: Transfer Color from Current Raster to Vertex
filters.shortDescription: Project the current raster image color onto the mesh vertices.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Projects color information from the current raster onto the mesh vertices using perspective projection. Optionally uses a software depth buffer to restrict projection to visible faces only.

parameters.label: Use depth for projection
parameters.help: If true, a depth buffer is used to restrict projection to visible faces only.

parameters.label: Depth threshold
parameters.help: Tolerance value for depth buffer comparison (shadow buffer).

parameters.label: Only on selection
parameters.help: If true, projection is only applied to selected vertices.

parameters.label: Color for unprojected areas
parameters.help: Areas that cannot be projected will be filled with this color. If all channels are 0, the original color is preserved.

parameters.label: Preserve occluded vertex colors
parameters.help: If true, depth-occluded vertices keep their original color instead of being assigned the blank color.

filters.name: Transfer Color from Visible Rasters to Vertex
filters.shortDescription: Project color from all visible rasters onto the mesh vertices with weighted blending.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Projects color information from all visible and valid rasters onto the mesh vertices using perspective projection and weighted blending. Weights can account for view angle, distance, image border proximity, depth discontinuities, and image alpha.

parameters.label: Depth threshold
parameters.help: Tolerance value for depth buffer comparison (shadow buffer).

parameters.label: Only on selection
parameters.help: If true, projection is only applied to selected vertices.

parameters.label: Use angle weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the angle between the surface normal and the view direction.

parameters.label: Use distance weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the vertex distance from the camera.

parameters.label: Use image border weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the pixel distance from the image boundaries.

parameters.label: Use depth discontinuity weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the pixel distance from depth discontinuities (silhouettes).

parameters.label: Use image alpha weight
parameters.help: If true, the alpha channel of the raster image is used as an additional weight.

parameters.label: Color for unprojected areas
parameters.help: Areas with no valid projection will be filled with this color. If all channels are 0, the original color is preserved.

parameters.label: Preserve occluded vertex colors
parameters.help: If true, depth-occluded vertices keep their original color instead of being assigned the blank color.

filters.name: Transfer Color from Visible Rasters to Texture
filters.shortDescription: Project color from all visible rasters onto a new mesh texture using wedge UV coordinates.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Projects color information from all visible and valid rasters onto a new texture image, using the mesh's existing wedge UV coordinates. The result is saved as a texture image and associated with the mesh.

parameters.label: Texture file
parameters.help: Output texture image file path.

parameters.label: Texture size (px)
parameters.help: Square texture image size in pixels. Should be a power of 2.

parameters.label: Fill atlas gaps
parameters.help: If true, unfilled areas of the texture atlas are interpolated using PullPush to avoid visible seams when mipmapping.

parameters.label: Depth threshold
parameters.help: Tolerance value for depth buffer comparison (shadow buffer).

parameters.label: Use angle weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the angle between the surface normal and the view direction.

parameters.label: Use distance weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the texel distance from the camera.

parameters.label: Use image border weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the pixel distance from the image boundaries.

parameters.label: Use depth discontinuity weight
parameters.help: If true, color contribution is weighted by the pixel distance from depth discontinuities (silhouettes).

parameters.label: Use image alpha weight
parameters.help: If true, the alpha channel of the raster image is used as an additional weight.
